title: Procedurally sealed stock-quant confirmation holdout
state: tasks, dataset revision, samples, metrics, and adapter policy frozen before E10d, E11a, or E11b model outcomes are observed
purpose: Provide a separately selected quality check for mechanically selected E11b service-frontier points without reusing the three E11a exploratory tasks or rewriting the original 30-task admission contract.

harness.adapter: Reuse the validated E10d serial exact-token probability_ids mechanism, tokenizer parity preflight, cache-isolated first token, per-sample logs, and raw compressed response retention.

tokenizer.parity_requirement: The pinned tokenizer must match llama.cpp /tokenize on the existing synthetic probes and every prepared MMLU context plus continuation.

dataset.license_source: Hugging Face dataset-card metadata at the pinned revision
dataset.known_limitation: MMLU is a public and widely used benchmark, so pretraining contamination cannot be excluded. Sealed here means that the task/sample contract is frozen and remains unevaluated until after exploratory service selection, not that the questions are secret.

tasks.purpose: professional judgment outside the exploratory science and commonsense tasks

planned_holdout.sample_selection: Salted SHA-256 ranking over public integer indices using pareto64-e11c-sealed-mmlu-v1; labels and model outputs are not inputs to selection.

candidate_policy.candidates: Every valid non-dominated E11b service-frontier point, selected mechanically only after E11b aggregate validation.
candidate_policy.empty_selection_rule: If E11b has no valid non-anchor promotion candidate, retain a stop-before-measurement decision rather than evaluating other E11a points.

decision_policy.promotion_rule: A candidate may be promoted only if it remains non-dominated when all three sealed accuracy coordinates are added to its frozen E11b quality, size, and service coordinates, and it passes all E11b validity gates.
decision_policy.negative_result_rule: Retain low, mixed, tied, or regressed accuracy, prediction disagreement, adapter failure, tokenizer mismatch, missing raw responses, and an empty candidate set without changing tasks, samples, metrics, adapter, or frontier policy.

claim_boundary: E11c is a procedurally sealed, public-benchmark confirmation on three exact MMLU subjects. It is supplemental evidence, does not establish secret-holdout generalization, cannot exclude benchmark contamination, does not rewrite the original admission contract, and supports no energy, PMU, local-device, fleet, cost, mixed-quant, imatrix, pruning, other-runtime, or general hardware claim.
